items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: That's a picture of Rose and me on the boat, before we left.

ctx.x: Do you remember who the other four musicians were?
No, but there was a very good drummer, who I can't remember, and a good trumpet player in New York, but I've forgotten what his name was. Do you remember, Rose? The trumpet player?
No, because I don't even remember Duke Ellington.

items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] His parents were nice, too. They were very nice to us when we went to Boston.

ctx.x: Oh, yes sir. Harry was always a nice fellow.
His parents were nice, too. They were very nice to us when we went to Boston.
I met his mother when I was in Boston.
